verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say it creates a new daily note every day for journaling. Multiple capture paths land there by default: web bookmarks and highlights, audio transcriptions, deep-link appends and calendar events. Nothing in the evidence shows daily notes being pre-filled from a user-defined template, which is a core element of the story. Missing for 10: template-based pre-filling of daily notes, any docs on daily-note customization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
